sn29.9:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
sn29.9:1.3: ko nu kho bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā saṃsedajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti. idha bhikkhu, ekacco kāyena dvayakārī hoti
sn29.9:1.5: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā saṃsedajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
